Best,

1) Confirm required tax doc type (W-9 vs W-8BEN-E) — we are a US subsidiary; W-9 will be supplied.

Laura and Neha — looping you in to validate the payload and sign off on the onboarding packet before I return to Samantha. Laura, can you check bank remit formatting? Neha, can you confirm the VAT placeholder behavior and whether our invoice generator can toggle VAT output per customer?

Thanks all — this is helpful. Quick answers and next steps from GreenWave AP: 

- Beneficiary name: must match legal_name field exactly in our portal. We can do a one-time manual accept but automated onboarding requires exact match.
- File size: CSV up to 2MB; JSON payload up to 1MB. For larger multi-line POs we accept a zipped payload.
- PO numbering: dash allowed (e.g., GW-PO-2457) and we pass it through to invoice matching.
- GL codes: not required at line-level for initial onboarding. We prefer header-level GL for the first 90 days; after that we can pilot line-level GL if Redwood can supply a mapping table.

Procurement asked me to confirm receipt of Redwood's packet — please upload redwood_ap_onboarding_packet.pdf to our portal (ap-admin@greenwave.com) and I'll fast-track activation. I'll keep you posted once the vendor record is live (should be by Friday EOD if uploads match).

Samantha

GreenWave Logistics
